---
title: "C5 and NRCAM axis prediction"
output: html_document
---

The prediction analyses used separate estimands for the Bader, Riviere-Cazaux
and all-study datasets. The included aggregate tables preserve those distinctions.
The script reproduces the model ladders and study forest plot and repeats the
random-effects pooling of the 35 study-level C5+NRCAM models. Participant-level
clinical and proteomic records are not distributed in this repository.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo <- if (dir.exists("../scripts")) normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo)
source(file.path(repo, "scripts", "09_axis_prediction.R"))
```

```{r results}
read.delim("analysis/09_axis_prediction/all_study_recomputed_meta_analysis.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

The figure is written to `analysis/09_axis_prediction/axis_prediction.pdf`.
